verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs and a deprecation policy are a fair question for an API and tool-integration platform like Composio, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows an OpenAPI spec, SDK sessions, a CLI and MCP endpoints, but nothing about API versioning or a deprecation policy. A published OpenAPI document is adjacent and does not establish either one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
